slug: 从车迟国开始布局西游
lines: 滴，彦祖亦菲打卡处。
看小说前先没收脑子！
车迟国，皇城，一间道观内，道观里供奉着上清通天圣人的宝像。
此时一名青年正跪在宝像前上香。
“师尊，当年封神量劫我们截教万仙要么上了封神榜，要么被西方教度化，徒儿不甘心！”
“我等一心向道，每日静颂皇庭，凭什么被人、阐、佛三教联手算计，便要我截教万仙，落得如此下场？！”
“徒儿日夜苦修，终于在西游量劫前修成了混元大罗金仙，徒儿要让这三界乱起来，好让上榜和被度化的师兄弟重归截教，恢复我截教万仙来朝的圣教模样！”
虚空之中，竟缓缓响起一声悠长而无奈的叹息，虚无缥缈，却又清晰地落在江辰耳畔:“唉，江辰吾徒，天命如此，何必强求?”
“师尊，什么是天命?您也说过，大道五十，天衍四九，尚存一线生机！”
“徒儿已证混元，圣人不出，三界之内，再无人能压我一头！这西游量劫，便是徒儿的机会！”
“唉，罢了罢了，既然你想搏一搏，老师自然支持你，”说着一道光从雕像里疾射而出:“此乃青萍剑，截教万仙见此剑如见本座，望你善加利用。”
“是，师尊！”
清香燃尽，雕像也没了动静，江辰站起身缓缓走出了道观，朝着东胜神洲而去。
江辰是后世而来的，附身开天第一棵松树化形，也算是福缘深厚之辈，化形之时就是太乙金仙的修为，不过在他知道所在的时间点是巫妖量劫的时候那是慌的一批。
巫妖量劫，那真的是准圣遍地走，太乙不如狗的时代，就自己这三两下子一个搞不好就嗝屁了。
不过身为穿越者江辰又怎么能少了穿越者的标配系统呢？
跟着江辰一起来的还有一个西游破坏系统，只要破坏西游那就有奖励。
这让江辰一下子emo了，好消息有系统，坏消息系统暂时用不了！
于是江辰只好一直缩在山里修行。
众所周知，修行者法地财侣都很重要，一直缩在山里又能有什么成就?
一个会元的时间江辰也不过是从太乙金仙初期修到太乙金仙中期。
这速度，根本就不配他的这个跟脚。
最要命的是在洪荒你要是没有实力，你永远不知道明天和死亡哪一个先到来。
虽然江辰老老实实的待在山中修行，但是还是差点被巫族的大巫给打杀了。
至于原因嘛也很简单，那个叫夸父的大巫说他是妖族，必须要除之而后快。
天可怜见，他自从化形以后就待在山中寸步不出，结果人家一见面就要杀自己。
还有王法吗？还有法律吗？
后面就是被夸父追杀的一千年，每每想到这一千年江辰都感到恼火。
content_en:
Oh, this is where Yanzu Yifei checks in.
Turn off your brain before reading the novel!
Chechi Kingdom, Imperial City, inside a Taoist temple, which enshrines a treasured statue of the Sage Tongtian.
At this time, a young man was kneeling in front of the statue to offer incense.
"Master, when we were conferred gods and calamities, we taught that tens of thousands of immortals were either on the list of conferred gods, or were converted by Western teachings, and my disciple was unwilling to accept it!"
"I am devoted to the Tao and chant the imperial court quietly every day. How come the three sects of Man, Chan, and Buddhism have jointly plotted to force me to intercept the teachings of thousands of immortals and end up like this?!"
"My disciple practiced hard day and night, and finally became the Hunyuan Daluo Golden Immortal before the calamity of Journey to the West. My disciple wants to cause chaos in the three realms, so that the brothers who have been listed and have been converted can return to the Jiejiao religion, and restore the holy religion that thousands of immortals from my Jiejiao religion have come to worship!"
In the void, a long and helpless sigh slowly sounded. It was ethereal, but it fell clearly on Jiang Chen's ears: "Alas, my disciple Jiang Chen, my destiny is like this, why force it?"
"Master, what is destiny? You also said that if the great path is fifty and the destiny is forty-nine, there is still a glimmer of hope!"
"My disciple has achieved Hunyuan. If the saint does not come out, no one in the Three Realms can beat me! This journey to the west is my opportunity!"
"Oh, that's all. Since you want to give it a try, the teacher will naturally support you," he said, and a light shot out from the statue: "This is the Qingping Sword. The thousands of immortals who see this sword are like seeing me. I hope you can make good use of it."
"Yes, Master!"
After the fragrance burned out and the statue became silent, Jiang Chen stood up and slowly walked out of the Taoist temple, heading towards Dongsheng Shenzhou.
…
Jiang Chen came from a later generation. He possessed the first pine tree in Kaitian and transformed into one. He can be regarded as a person with profound blessings. When he transformed, he had the cultivation level of Taiyi Golden Immortal. However, when he knew that the time was when the lich was measuring the calamity, he was a panicked group.
When the lich measured calamity, it was really an era when quasi-sages were everywhere, and Taiyi was not as good as a dog. Just one of these three or two might end up in ruins.
But as a time traveler, how could Jiang Chen be without the standard system for time travellers?
Along with Jiang Chen, there is also a Journey to the West destruction system. As long as you destroy Journey to the West, you will be rewarded.
This made Jiang Chen suddenly emo. The good news is that there is a system, but the bad news is that the system cannot be used for the time being!
So Jiang Chen had no choice but to huddle in the mountains and practice.
As we all know, a practitioner’s Dharma, earth, and wealth are very important. What achievements can be achieved by hiding in the mountains all the time?
In one Huiyuan, Jiang Chen only cultivated from the early stage of Taiyi Golden Immortal to the middle stage of Taiyi Golden Immortal.
This speed is simply not worthy of his heels.
The most terrible thing is that if you don't have strength in the prehistoric times, you will never know which will come first, tomorrow or death.
Although Jiang Chen stayed in the mountains to practice, he was still almost killed by the great witch of the witch clan.
As for the reason, it is very simple. The great witch named Kuafu said that he was a demon clan and must be eliminated quickly.
It's so pitiful that he has been staying in the mountains since he transformed. As a result, people want to kill him whenever they see him.
Is there any royal law? Are there any laws?
What follows is a thousand years of being chased by Kuafu. Jiang Chen feels annoyed every time he thinks of these thousand years.
